recipe.prompt: A professional, publication-quality scientific flowchart diagram showing the SciForge Agentic Research Sprint pipeline. Clean horizontal flow diagram with rounded rectangle stages connected by directional arrows on a white background. Title at top: 'SciForge Agentic Research Sprint'. Stages flowing left to right: 1) Research Question ('Which molecular systems drive cells into meiosis?'), 2) Literature Triage (~164 papers via Exploration Hub), 3) Candidate Gene ID (23 genes, 12 classes), 4) Hypothesis Formalization (PI-directed), 5) Multi-Omics Evidence Synthesis, 6) AlphaFold3 Structural Validation, 7) DCT-M3 Framework Triangulation (Permissive → Brake → Trigger → Competence), 8) Versioned Reports & Evidence Gates, 9) Living Manuscript Integration, 10) Git-Tracked Package. Color scheme: blue for early research stages, green for evidence/validation stages, orange for integration/output stages. Bottom banner: '132 Stages | 199 Commits | 6 Sub-agents | 9 Figures | ~164 Papers | ~85 Evidence Sources'. Clean modern academic style suitable for Nature/Science journal, vector-like appearance, no photo-realistic elements, sharp typography, professional diagram illustration.
